description: Watch every GitHub Actions run of your BB projects, start any workflow with its inputs, and hand failures to an agent. A failed job opens its log at the error line, and Ask agent starts a thread with that excerpt and a brief to find the root cause. Run workflow turns a workflow_dispatch trigger into a form with branch, choice, and boolean inputs, checked before the request reaches GitHub. Rerun failed jobs, cancel a run, or send a run report to the BB threads you pick and subscribe them to new failures. Requires a GitHub account: the plugin uses the gh CLI login on the BB server machine, or a token you set.
